# Isaiah Chapter 32 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 20 verses]*

*Righteous king; fools exposed; complacent women warned; Spirit poured out; wilderness becomes garden*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 32 (A King in Righteousness) addresses righteous king; fools exposed; complacent women warned; spirit poured out; wilderness becomes garden. The key verse — "The fruit of righteousness will be peace; its effect will be quietness and confidence forever" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
